title: Dhaadannoo Warra Hin Dhalanne
intro: Lubbuun garaa qulqulluun osoo daa’imni hin dhufin waadaa qulqulluu galte. Seenaan fakkii kanaa dallaa mana qulqulluu tokkoo keessatti kan mul’atu yoo ta’u, bakka of kennuu fudhatama waaqaatiin wal argu. Gabrichi Rabbii kun eenyu?
clues: Maatii Qur'aana keessatti kabajame keessaa ture.
Mucaa koo isa garaa keessa jiru tajaajila Rabbiif akkan of kennu waadaa cimaa seene.
Yeroon deessu ilma eegee ture ta'us intala ta'uu ishee argachuun na ajaa'ibe.
Mucaa koo maqaa of kennuu fi tajaajila calaqqisiisu Maariyaam jedheen moggaase.
Mucaa koo fi sanyii isheetiif eegumsa Rabbii sheyxaana abaaramaa irraa barbaade.
Mucaan koo Gooftaan fudhatama argatee kunuunsa Nabi Zakaariyaa jala bakka qulqulluutti galfame.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Mucaa ishee mana qulqullummaaf akka kennitu dhaadachuu
trial.answer: Mucaa ishee mana qulqullummaaf akka kennitu dhaadachuu

options: Iddoo qulqulluu (mihrab) mucaan ishee itti kaa'ame
location.answer: Iddoo qulqulluu (mihrab) mucaan ishee itti kaa'ame

outcome.answer: Mucaan ishee fudhatama argatee kunuunsa Nabi Zakaariyaa jala galfame

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
